html:
Frosted bathroom windows are a great option if you’re after privacy but don’t want to reduce the amount of light coming into your bathroom. Below, discover the benefits of home window tinting and find out more about our bathroom window privacy film.

Tint a Home specialises in frosted glass film for bathrooms and with over 42 years of providing tinting services in Australia, we are Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. We have stores located throughout Australia and all our films are government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. Here are the benefits of our bathroom windows frosted glass service and the other home window tinting films we offer.

Bathroom Window Frosting Film

Bathroom windows frosted glass film can not only be used for privacy glass windows in your bathroom but can also be used on internal glass for additional privacy, or to act as a divider. In addition to plain bathroom window frosting film, we also have a range of designs available or you can even customise your design.

Our frosted glass film for bathrooms is installed by professionally trained installers and we offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications. Bathroom window frosting film also offers the following benefits:

  • A reduction in heat
  • Increased safety from broken glass caused by accidents or severe weather
  • A reduction in glare

In addition to bathroom window frosting film, we also offer the following films for the rest of your home:

  • Solar window film
  • Security window film
  • Privacy window film
  • Safety window film
  • Frosted / decorative window film
  • Four seasons (environmentally friendly) window film

So, while you’re having frosted window film added to your bathroom, you can also have the rest of your home’s windows tinted and can enjoy a more comfortable year-round temperature, protection from UV rays and added safety & security for you and your family.

Get A Quote For Frosted Glass Film For Your Bathroom

Use our Store Finder to find your nearest bathroom window frosting film store and speak with our experts about privacy glass windows for your bathroom. Call 13TINT to speak with our friendly customer service team if you have any questions regarding bathroom window privacy film.
